  The Board discussed having the City pay for a portion of the fee

  Chairperson Walters stated that it would be a benefit to have outside eyes evaluate
  and explore other funding mechanisms outside the current events.

  Mr. Domer stated that the City did not budget for the expense this fiscal year, but
  the Board could ask City Council.

  Mayor Hepburn feels the analysis is important and a partnership with the district
  and Chamber is beneficial.

  It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the proposal if
  the BID and the City split the cost. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Dr. Espinoza announced that the Latino Expo
  will be hosted on September l4th and ULV will be hosting a voting center.
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm stated that the tree decorator will be $1,900,
  previously it costs $1,200. Ms. Rehm will coordinate the post card but asked for
  volunteers to coordinate the entertainment and tree delivery and set up. Dr. Espinoza
  will check to see if the ULV choir is available. Mr. Henderson willcontact Sanders
  Towing and ask if they can pick up and deliver the tree to Mainiero Square.
  D. Chamber Report (Wayne Hurley): Mr. Hurley stated that Michael Mergil is working
  to hire a new director and support staff. Mr. Hurley will reach out to ULV for
  support.
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm received website proposals to discuss
  at the Association meeting.
  F. Financial Report: None
7  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Jason Cruz of 1236 Highland Drive was present at the meeting. Mr. Cruz is opposed to
  the patio expansion at Cafe Wang restaurant.

  Mr. Scherer explained that the Board already voted for the removal of the patio
  expansion. Staff is working to draft a new policy. In the meantime, City Council
 I

  approved the patio through June 2025. The draft policy will be brought to City Council
